subject: Unite function output is methylBase object with 1 row

messages.author: 2cbd15cbd202b058
messages.subject: Unite function output is methylBase object with 1 row
parts:
Hello,

When I use the unite function to merge samples, the output always has one row. I've tried adjusting the min.per.group argument. This also produced a methylBase object with 1 row but for a different locus:

```
> meth=unite(myobj, destrand=FALSE)
> head(meth)
methylBase object with 1 rows
--------------
   chr  start    end strand coverage1 numCs1 numTs1 coverage2 ...
1 chr1 292975 292975      -        63     49     14 ....
```

```
> meth.min=unite(myobj, min.per.group = 1L, destrand=FALSE)
> head(meth.min)
methylBase object with 1 rows
--------------
   chr start end strand coverage1 numCs1 numTs1 coverage2 ....
1 chr1   333 333      -        10      5      5 ...
```

I have no idea where to begin troubleshooting. 
Reads were aligned with bwameth to reference of a congener and methylation calls were extracted using MethylDackel.

Thank you for your help. 

All the best,
Leslie
